codeReview.issue: The icon colour is set on the icon element itself (`.marker svg { color: var(--ds-color-icon-subtle) }`). The icon colour rule says to put the token on the ancestor. The component's own metadata anti-pattern also says it 'sets color.icon.subtle on the marker ancestor', so the code and the metadata disagree. It renders the same today because Icon uses currentColor and Text sets its own colour. CardHorizontal has the same `.badge svg` pattern, which is probably where this was copied from.
codeReview.fix: Replace `.marker svg { … }` with `color: var(--ds-color-icon-subtle);` inside the existing `.marker` rule.

codeReview.issue: `data-status={status}` is written to the root, but no CSS or test reads it. The exported `CardVerticalStatus` type only exists to describe it. The derived status is otherwise only used for `completed`.
codeReview.fix: Either drop `data-status` and inline `const completed = progress !== undefined && progress >= 100`, or keep it on purpose as a styling/test hook and say so in the metadata. Optional.

codeReview.issue: The `Row` story hard-codes `progress={30}`, `progress={100}` and `certified` in `render`, and repeats inline-styled 280px wrappers. This conflicts with the story convention that prop values go in `args`, not hard-coded. Every story also repeats the same `thumbnailSrc`/`title`/`duration` args.
codeReview.fix: Move the shared args into `meta.args`, and either drop `Row` (the individual state stories already cover each state) or keep it as a documented showcase with no controls.

a11y.issue: The article and the progressbar are both named by the same title id. A screen reader moving through the card hears the course title twice: once as the article name and once as the progressbar name. This matches the metadata contract and CardHorizontal, so it is consistent, but it is repetitive.
a11y.fix: Optional: keep it as is for consistency with CardHorizontal, or later let ProgressBar accept `aria-labelledby` plus a short `aria-label` prefix, or pass `label="Course progress"`. Any change belongs in ProgressBar, not here.
